_about: The four dials of the base (scripts/sim/policies.gd, S25.2 of the round 25 plan): the numbers and the words. A missing number is neutral (1.0 or 0.0). 'usual' boldness carries no numbers: it is scavenge.gd's own errand constants. Every option's mood line is what the Mood tooltip lists while it stands; 'fever' is the outbreak risk it adds to every slow look (dilemmas).

worn.label: Worn out
worn.sub: Overtime is wearing the crew down. The Rest priority rotates them; normal hours let them recover.

spent.label: Spent
spent.sub: Work and mood are failing. Give them rest or call off the overtime.

gate.clear_sub: Let in a day after the call.
gate.bitten_sub: Turned back. The radio will go on calling.
gate.alert: {name} was turned back at the gate

rations.title: Rations
rations.ask: How much does everyone eat and drink?

full.name: Full
full.blurb: Everyone eats and drinks their fill, as it is now.
cons: Food and water run down at the full rate
full.news: Rations: full. Everyone eats their fill again.
full.sub: The stores run down at the full rate.

half.name: Half
half.blurb: A quarter less food and 15% less water for everyone.
cons: Mood -3 (Half rations)
A little more risk of fever
half.news: Rations: half. Everyone eats a quarter less.
half.sub: The stores last longer. Mood -3 for everyone while it stands.

hungry.name: Hungry
hungry.blurb: Half the food and 30% less water. It will show in the work.
pros: Food lasts twice as long, water 43% longer
cons: Mood -8 (Hungry on purpose)
Work and aim 8% worse
More risk of fever
hungry.news: Rations: hungry. Everyone eats half, and it shows.
hungry.sub: The stores last twice as long. Mood -8, work and aim 8% worse.

hours.title: Work hours
hours.ask: How hard does the base work?

normal.name: Normal
normal.blurb: A day's work, and then rest. Nobody wears out.
pros: Nobody wears out; the worn recover
cons: The bench, the beds and the crew work at the usual pace
normal.news: Work hours: normal. The crew eases off.
normal.sub: Nobody gains weariness; the worn begin to recover.

overtime.name: Overtime
overtime.blurb: Everyone works longer: 25% more crafting, mending, building and garden food.
pros: 25% more ammo, mending, building and food from the beds
cons: Mood -3 (Overtime)
Worn out in about six days: mood -4, work 10% worse
Spent after that: mood -8, work 20% worse
More risk of fever once someone is worn out
overtime.news: Work hours: overtime. Everyone works harder, and it will tell.
overtime.sub: 25% more made. Mood -3, and weariness builds while people work.

boldness.title: Scavengers
boldness.ask: How much do the scavenging parties risk?

careful.name: Careful
careful.limit: Careful: not to a place this dangerous (danger {danger} of 3).
careful.blurb: Parties keep to the quiet places and turn back from trouble.
pros: Half the chance of not coming back
cons: Only places of danger 1 or less
50% of the loot instead of 60%
Clearing a place 10 points less likely
careful.news: Scavengers: careful. They go only where it is quiet.
careful.sub: Only places of danger 1 or less; 50% of the loot, fewer wounds.

usual.name: Usual
usual.blurb: As the parties have always gone.
cons: 60% of the loot, wounds x1.5, 3% a danger point of not coming back

bold.name: Bold
bold.blurb: Parties push their luck: more to carry home, more to lose.
cons: Wounds x2.0 instead of x1.5
5% a danger point of not coming back instead of 3%
bold.news: Scavengers: bold. They push their luck for more.
bold.sub: 80% of the loot, wounds x2, losses likelier.

let_in.name: Let in
let_in.blurb: Anyone who calls and is told the way comes in at the gate the next morning.
pros: New hands as fast as the beds allow
cons: A bitten stranger walks in with the rest
let_in.news: Strangers: let in. Callers are told the way and come in as before.

check.name: Check
check.blurb: Everyone who arrives is looked over at the gate, and comes a day later.
pros: A bitten stranger is turned back at the gate
cons: Everyone arrives a day later
check.news: Strangers: checked. Callers come a day later and are looked over at the gate.
check.sub: A bitten stranger is turned back. Arrivals come a day later.

turn_away.name: Turn away
turn_away.blurb: No stranger's call is taken. Ana, Walt and Hector still come.
pros: No new mouths and no one bitten walks in
cons: No new hands: the crew only shrinks
turn_away.news: Strangers: turned away. The radio hour stays quiet.
turn_away.sub: No stranger's call comes. Ana, Walt and Hector still do.
